subject: Demo entry for training. Delete after.
htmlBody:
This demo case shows how a new Canadian SR&ED case is added. It mentions scientific research and experimental development (SR&ED), the investment tax credit, and qualified SR&ED expenditures, so the site links them to the glossary automatically.

Background

The taxpayer claimed SR&ED expenditures for a software project and an investment tax credit (ITC) under section 37 of the Income Tax Act.

Decision

The Tax Court of Canada reviewed whether the work met the definition of SR&ED. This is sample text for the training video only.
title: Demo Case v. The King (2025 TCC)
